PassCondition: Every input vector appears exactly once; expected and resolved fields match; all Status=PASS.
All TS 38.104 table entries and N/A pairs are covered exactly once; strict invalid pairs throw the expected ID.
Exactly one row per symbol; CommonDirection remains D/U/F; only F may be overridden by dedicated or scheduler resolution.
No duplicate occupied RE key unless explicit multiplexing is supported; every collision is either rejected or explicitly rate-matched.
Every vector has the expected legality and reason code; no allocation is auto-shifted.
WindowingSamples=0 for strict vectors; dimensions match nrOFDMInfo; no-channel round trip NMSE<=1e-12 and EVM<=1e-4 percent.
Target times are computed in one absolute timeline; TDD availability and N1/N2 processing limits are enforced.
Switch activation follows the configured procedure and no grant uses an inactive BWP.
Two-CC tests show no grid, BWP, HARQ, timing or CSI state leakage.
Failed=0, Skipped=0 and Blocked=0 for every mandatory suite.
Every required image passes figure-object checks before export and binary/nonblank/hash checks after export.
